text:
sara: Hey team, small diplomatic incident: the blue stapler from 3A has gone missing. Anyone seen it? :eyes:
lee: I may have "relocated" it to my desk for an emergency TPS report. It was a lone staple, no witnesses. :sweat_smile: (reactions: :grimacing:)
tay: That's an act of stapler appropriation. The blue stapler is legally the property of Team Paperclips. We demand a formal extradition. :scroll: (reactions: :eyes:)
alex: Suggest a peaceful summit. Trade proposal: stapler for a box of churros. I'm willing to broker. :churro: (reactions: :handshake:)
kira: I call upon neutral mediation—facilities-bot, can you arbitrate? :raised_hand: (reactions: :pray:)
facilities-bot: facilities-bot: Reminder: Please do not remove communal office supplies without sign-out. If you took the stapler, submit the Lost & Found form: https://intranet/internal/lost-and-found (automated notice)
lee: Filed the form. Also drafted a provisional treaty: 
```
Treaty of the Stapler Summit
- Blue stapler returned by EOD Thursday
- Replace with equal-or-better adhesive dispenser if damaged
- Mandatory reconciliation cookies at handoff
```
sara: I accept. Summit scheduled: Thursday 16:30 in the pantry. Bring cookies or a solemn poem. :cookie: :open_book: (reactions: :thumbsup:)
tay: I'll bring a haiku for the reconciliation ceremony. This will be recorded in lore as the Great Staple Accord. :scroll:
alex: Can we get a photo for all-hands? This needs to be memorialized. :camera_with_flash:
kira: Adding to the Office Museum: upon return the stapler will receive an honorary sash and a small plaque. Maybe a loo-roll throne upgrade? :crown:
sara: Court adjourned until Thursday. May the staples be ever in your favor. :star:
